play.gyroHint: Tap to allow motion — tilt your phone for real parallax
play.cameraHint: Open the rear camera, pinch a face with thumb + index, hold still to lock the whole face, turn your fingers to twist it, and open your fingers to unlock and pick another face
play.cameraDenied: No camera access — switched to touch control

hud.handNoneBanner: No hand · raise it to the camera

play.experimentalSwipe: Pinch the two fingers onto a face → hold still to lock that face → turn your two fingers to twist ONLY that face; open your fingers to unlock and pick another
play.palmSpin: Open palm · touch the cube and drag to rotate the whole cube
play.faceLocked: Face locked · turns this face only, open fingers to unlock

intro.title: A few steps before you start

hold.title: Put your hand behind the phone
hold.body: Point the phone at the space the cube lives in and gesture in front of the lens. Only your two fingertips show on screen — never the camera feed.

pinch.title: Pinch with thumb + index
pinch.body: Pinch to grab a face, hold still a moment to lock it, then turn your two fingers to twist it.

depth.title: Turn your fingers to twist
depth.body: Once locked, keep pinching and rotate your two fingers to twist that face; open your fingers to unlock and grab another.

intro.perms: Needs two permissions: camera (to read gestures) + motion/gyro (for the 3D view). Allow both in the system prompts after you tap Start.

play.signInToSave: Sign in to save your result
play.twistHint: Drag on any cube face to twist that layer
